name: variants
description: Named-state map for orchestrating multi-state animations. Pass strings to Motion.* `initial`/`animate` to switch between states declaratively.

props.name: states
props.description: Object whose keys are state names and values are `AnimateProps` (with optional per-state `transition`).

examples.title: Open/closed dialog
examples.description: A two-state map for a dialog overlay.

ai.whenToUse: Use whenever a component switches between two or more discrete states (open/closed, enabled/disabled, expanded/collapsed). Lets the JSX read as state transitions, not raw transforms.
ai.whenNotToUse: Don't use for one-shot animations — passing the AnimateProps object inline to `animate` is simpler.
commonMistakes: Defining variants inline in render — each render creates a new map and re-runs every animation. Hoist or memoize.
Using state names that don't match a key in the variants map — the engine silently no-ops.
ai.accessibilityNotes: No accessibility implications beyond the underlying Motion element.
